svg.aria-label: Data flow of the Accounts Receivable Power BI project. The Excel sheet Data is read by one Power Query query, Entity Name (Data). The data model has the fact table plus five dimension tables built from it (Date, Client, Project, Aging, Billing Timing), a Metric field parameter and 14 measures in one measures table, with 8 relationships. The measures feed 5 report pages.
svg.title: Accounts Receivable data flow
